answer_1.quote: We study VEQA, an important and commonly used subset of VQA, but it is not fully explored.

answer_2.quote: For Single-VEQA queries, we use accuracy (Acc) as an evaluation metric. Furthermore, we assess the accuracy only for instances where relevant clues are successfully retrieved ... For Group-VEQA queries, we employ recall (Recall) as the metric.

answer_4.quote: Human: This represents the human-annotated results, showcasing the level of cognitive ability and performance that humans can achieve on this task.
answer_4.guideline: Human identification accuracy reaches 98.31% when incorporating matching clues, setting a high benchmark for model performance.
